text: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we work. Automation now handles many repetitive tasks, allowing employees to focus on more creative and complex work. Productivity tools powered by AI, such as smart calendars and writing assistants, help workers save time and make fewer mistakes. Human-AI collaboration is also becoming common, with people and machines working together to solve problems faster. However, these changes also affect jobs. Some roles may disappear, while new ones will appear, and many existing jobs will require new skills. For this reason, workers should keep learning and adapting to succeed in the modern workplace.
